fusions.name: Rim Bash
fusions.desc: A shield-first blow that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoving Sweep
fusions.desc: Shoves a short cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it.

fusions.name: Raised Rim
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 25 damage and holds for 8 seconds, hardening your armour by 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Narrow Miss
fusions.desc: Your armour is permanently increased by 12%.
